## Eligibility and estimates
PM Surya Ghar assistance is available only to eligible applicants and depends on current scheme requirements, compliant equipment, commissioning and application approval. The calculator provides indicative figures, not a quotation. Actual cost, generation, bill savings, payback and warranty terms depend on the property, equipment and written project scope.
